# JesseSort benchmark results

- seed policy: one deterministic unique seed per trial; paired across all algorithms
- trials by size: 1k=500, 10k=500, 100k=500, 1m=50
- sizes: 1k, 10k, 100k, 1m

Cells show **median paired ratio vs std::sort (median time in us)**. Values below 1.0 are faster than std::sort. Pending cells have not completed yet.
